file_name.description: Name of the file to be processed. The location of the file depends on the context
file_name.title: File name

service_point_id.description: Service point to be used for transactions created from this file (Loans-only).
service_point_id.title: Service point ID

statistical_code.description: Statistical code (code) to be used inventory records created from this file (Instances, Holdings, Items). Specify multiple codes using multi_field_delimiter.
statistical_code.title: Statistical code

create_source_records.description: If set to true, the source records will be created in FOLIO. If set to false, the source records will not be created in FOLIO. Only applied for MARC-based transformations.
create_source_records.title: Create source records

data_import_marc.description: If set to true, successfully processed MARC records from this file will be included in the MARC file for data import generated by the parent task for inventory records created from this file. Only applied for MARC-based transformations.
data_import_marc.title: Data import MARC

description: The tenant ID to use when making requests to FOLIO APIs for this task, if different from library configuration
ecsTenantId.title: ECS tenant ID

files.description: List of delimited files containing the legacy instances.
files.title: Files

instancesMappingFileName.description: File name for the instances mapping. Must map legacyIdentifier and a title.
instancesMappingFileName.title: Instances mapping file name

instanceTypesMapFileName.description: File name for the instance type map. A TSV file with a legacy value column and a folio_name or folio_code column.
instanceTypesMapFileName.title: Instance types map file name

natureOfContentMapFileName.description: Optional file name for the nature of content term map.
natureOfContentMapFileName.title: Nature of content map file name

instanceFormatsMapFileName.description: Optional file name for the instance format map.
instanceFormatsMapFileName.title: Instance formats map file name

modesOfIssuanceMapFileName.description: Optional file name for the mode of issuance map.
modesOfIssuanceMapFileName.title: Modes of issuance map file name

contributorTypesMapFileName.description: Optional file name for the contributor type map.
contributorTypesMapFileName.title: Contributor types map file name

identifierTypesMapFileName.description: Optional file name for an identifier type mapping table. A TSV with legacy_identifier_type and folio_name columns. When absent, values are resolved directly as FOLIO names or UUIDs.
identifierTypesMapFileName.title: Identifier types map file name

contributorNameTypesMapFileName.description: Optional file name for a contributor name type mapping table. A TSV with legacy_contributor_name_type and folio_name columns. When absent, values are resolved directly as FOLIO names or UUIDs.
contributorNameTypesMapFileName.title: Contributor name types map file name

instanceNoteTypesMapFileName.description: Optional file name for an instance note type mapping table. A TSV with legacy_note_type and folio_name columns. When absent, values are resolved directly as FOLIO names or UUIDs.
instanceNoteTypesMapFileName.title: Instance note types map file name

statisticalCodesMapFileName.description: Optional file name for the statistical code map. The file should be in TSV format with legacy_stat_code and folio_code columns.
statisticalCodesMapFileName.title: Statistical code map file name

addAdministrativeNotesWithLegacyIds.description: If set to true, an administrative note containing the legacy ID is added to each instance, protecting the value from overlays.
addAdministrativeNotesWithLegacyIds.title: Add administrative notes with legacy IDs
